app.title: deep union web
app.description: a web tool to request and offer help from nearby strangers in a structured manner

footer.tip: If this was useful you can

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Submit your requests offers visual description and current coordinates. They all stay local to you.
howItWorks.step2: You can choose to post everything in our database so others can find you.
howItWorks.step3: Select other users in the Map section to see how well your requests and offers match.
howItWorks.step4: If you choose to approach them you can see their visual description so you know how they look and their distance and direction from your location so you know where to go.

about.intro: We hope this app reminds you of the magic that is already out there in the world. As you use it we invite you to allow yourself to:
about.point1: Be clear about your deeper desires instead of being pushed around by expectations.
about.point2: Receive help from someone you may not have considered that could enrich your life.
about.point3: See your life in many more dimensions than just survival and pleasure.
about.point4: Fulfill different needs than the ones you have already covered (i.e. don't continuously fulfill the same one/s).
about.point5: Blur the lines between giving and receiving help which may help discover a deeper reality than the apparent separation we experience. In other words be open to what you might receive while giving.

need.explanationRequestExpression: e.g. say what has been hard to say
need.explanationRequestReflection: e.g. find clarity and truth about how you limit yourself without your awareness
need.explanationRequestKnowledge: e.g. let your identity be universal
need.explanationOfferDefinition: e.g. help someone succeed in a great project
